question: Which planet in our solar system is the farthest from the Sun?
answer:
Neptune is the farthest planet from the Sun; NASA calls it the eighth and most distant major planet in our solar system [1][2]. It orbits more than 30 times as far from the Sun as Earth does [1]. Pluto was once counted as the ninth planet, but the International Astronomical Union reclassified it as a dwarf planet in 2006, which cut the planet count from nine to eight [2].

A hypothetical "Planet Nine" would be a giant planet far beyond Neptune, but its existence is unconfirmed [3][5]. NASA says direct evidence of another planet has yet to be found [2], and a November 2026 Scientific American column says it is not known whether such a planet exists [5].
